episodes.title: Corbenic
episodes.summary: Beacon 23's secrets are exposed by an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Wreckers
episodes.summary: As Wreckers force their way onboard, Aster will have to put her trust in an enemy to survive.

episodes.title: Why Can't We Go On as Three?
episodes.summary: In shock after her first kill, Aster buries her feelings as she and Halan prepare for QTA Manager Coley to arrive on the beacon; Coley immediately distrusts Halan and sees him as a threat, forcing Aster to make a tough decision.

episodes.title: God in the Machine
episodes.summary: In the early days of Beacon 23's history, Sophie receives a surprise visit, forcing her AI to act.

episodes.title: Rocky
episodes.summary: While uncovering Halan's past, Aster finds a link to the rocks that will alter both their lives.

episodes.title: Beacon Twenty Three
episodes.summary: Going back in time to show how the rocks first appeared on Beacon 23.

episodes.title: End Transmission
episodes.summary: An organization known as "The Column" arrives at Beacon 23, revealing even more about the rocks.

episodes.title: Adamantine
episodes.summary: The QTA Mothership descends on Beacon 23, and Aster must make a life-or-death decision.

episodes.title: Godspeed
episodes.summary: Returning to Beacon 23, the inhabitants are still trapped under Aleph's watchful eye. After Aster's plan was cut short, Halan decides to see it through.

episodes.title: Purgatory
episodes.summary: Trapped within AI headquarters, Harmony must find a way to break free and return to Beacon 23.

episodes.title: Iris
episodes.summary: Iris, keeper of Beacon 67, learns of Halan's distress on Beacon 23; she decides to go help and is stunned by the disrepair; as they go about repairing the beacon, a strange occurrence leaves them confused and terrified.

episodes.title: Berth
episodes.summary: Iris desperately tries to piece together what happened to the pilot, while Harmony deals with a rogue AI who followed her to Beacon 23.

episodes.title: Song of Sorrow
episodes.summary: Emerging from the pocket universe, Dosto is strangely elusive about the whereabouts of his crew; Halan and Iris get a distress call.

episodes.title: Luan Casca
episodes.summary: Beacon Keeper Jocko welcomes a new trainee on Beacon 90, a teenage Aster; Aster senses Jocko is hiding something.

episodes.title: Free
episodes.summary: Imprisoned by the Sybarrans, Halan and Iris must work together to reclaim the beacon. Halan's past catches up to him when a military ship comes looking for the lost Sybarrans.

episodes.title: Disintegration
episodes.summary: After agreeing to receive an implant, Halan is surprised to find that the procedure puts him face-to-face with Aleph; Harmony protects the beacon by any means necessary.
